checks: Notes open immediately in a nonmodal right panel; a flushed label edit preserves notes and metadata, and explicit Close returns focus to its card.
Hover is passive; + opens a focused nonmodal draft with short contextual alternatives, while Escape preserves drafts and discard writes nothing.
The first contextual choice opens an unsaved suitable child beneath its own card; saving preserves frameworks, while the separate chevron only collapses or expands.
Keyboard Enter on + and A both start writing; draft alternatives are optional, and another card cannot steal an unsaved draft or change its parent.
The branch chooser is anchored and nonmodal; Escape returns focus and outside dismissal writes nothing.
One click applies a type to the selected branch, closes the chooser and preserves deeper overrides.
A delayed type save pauses selection and editing; after it finishes, fresh wording saves with working notes preserved.
Standalone export keeps direct editing and the complete state without changing the live session.
The direct controls and short chooser work at 390px without script errors.
Solution draft alternatives add qualitative Driver cards; A adds a proposed solution, Undo preserves the tree, exploration suggests Solution, and numerical Driver subtrees still add metrics.
